gripper_mapping.note: Use zero as a sweep parameter; do not infer torque from aux.gripper_current. At t~7.0 s action is ~47.18 with current ~-44; t~7.5-10 s action ~47.03 with current -76..-74 in a representative episode.

target_inference.interpretation: The demonstrated path approaches shoe1 (x=0.2445), closes near t~7 s, then rises. It does not simultaneously grasp shoe0 (x=0.1725). Treat shoe0 as a second-object/randomization candidate, not a bilateral same-time grasp target.

recommended_rl_curriculum: Train on shoe1 first with bilateral contact and lift >= 0.03 m as success.
Randomize shoe x/y by <=0.002 m and gripper zero over 46.6..47.2 during calibration.
Use demonstration actions as residual/reference prior; initial state must be explicit median pose, not first action.
Report physical-contact success separately from any attachment/weld proxy success.
